FILL (C232 · Vietnam · 2003 · 1000 đồng · VND (VN.KM.71)): the exact entry URL for the coin we hold + the line you read (`new` = a list with each side in brackets, e.g. ["Arnold Machin (obverse)", "Stuart Devlin (reverse)"]; leave FILL when the entry does not say)

FILL (C233 · Colombia · 2016 · 50 pesos · COP (CO.KM.295)): the exact entry URL for the coin we hold + the line you read (`new` = what the reverse shows, then its legend in capitals, joined by ' · '; the text covers every year of the type, so write the year as date and a mint letter that changes from mint to mint as mint mark (never the year or mint of the coin in the entry's photo); leave FILL when the entry does not say)
